title: What happened to this beautiful study app?!
text: I used to LOVE Quizlet. A year ago it would have 5/5 stars. I have used it all throughout undergrad and halfway through my grad school program. The learn function is amazing and they make it super easy to share sets with friends. But now they decide to add a little spice and I am NOT a fan. This new update is the PLAGUE! The app requires me to “Press and Hold” a button to prove I’m not a bot every single time I open it.  And instead of cards being stacked side by side while editing, it’s one uniform line and everything looks so bulky and spaced out. The app will glitch every now and then while editing as well, preventing me from using the tab button to switch to a new card or use the arrows on my keyboard to quickly navigate my text. I have also had issues with 70+ random drafts (not exaggerating, I’ve counted) appearing with zero cards in them & my freshly made quizlets randomly deleting after saving. I’ve reached out to customer service twice now and the first issue is still not fixed. I pay for Quizlet+ too, but this is not the update I expected my money to go towards…

title: It’s okay, but too many distracting ads
text: The advertisements feel intrusive and draining, and I don’t appreciate how it mixes in dark patterns to get you to use the app, even though some parts are useful. If it switched to using less invasive and coercive methods of asking for my money or advertising features, I’d be more inclined to pay for it. For example, offer me 24 non consecutive hours of studying on a + plan instead of a free trial with automatic recurring payments. I would much rather have an option to pay for individual sessions rather than a subscription. When companies use tricky tactics, it makes me so angry that I start looking for alternatives and calling my local representatives asking them to create stricter regulations for companies like this.

title: a plea from someone who remembers.
text:
i wrote a long, kindly worded review, earlier. i was working on developing something that while hurt, while sad, was a plea for the good graces of quizlet. a mere glance back at what was, what could be again.
then, i swiped away for a second. when i came back, my review that i was so devotedly developing was Gone. not a trace left. it took with it my kindness, my love, and my respect. may this new review represent the loss i feel, the anger i have, and the disrespect that rings through my mind each time i open the quizlet app.
i have not forgotten what was once given to us, quizlet. the learn option, which is the most conducive, useful, and effective option, to actually promote my learning, many years ago. it has been taken from me. like a disgraced pauper, i lap up the last drips of water from your outstretched palm, using the few learn opportunities provided to us. it does not taste sweet to me, anymore, quizlet. it fills me with spite. in a place where once learning was freely given, you, quizlet, have taken away. instead of developing a new option, for which one could pay to have, you decided a subscription based model that removes the majority of worth that comes with your app, available only to those who are able to afford. i can’t, quizlet. i am a in debt doctorate student who cannot afford rent. and even if could, why must i pay to learn? why must i pay to have what was freely, generously, rightfully offered to me in the past? 
i still use the app. but instead of opening the app with a burst of joy, and exclamation of “i love quizlet,” i do so begrudgingly. i am frustrated. i hurt. i long for what once was. for when things were good. i have been castaway, tossed aside for the promise of profit. 
i know things must change. i know it is the one constant in life. but why must it be for the worse? why must growth only equal the amount of money made? i used to use quizlet in joy. now i feel as if i’m standing in the wreckage of the town i grew up in, watching the people who raised me burn it to the ground. 
and yet, with all the hurt bubbling inside me, i still want to forgive you. i want to look back on this time with kindness. this is a call to action, quizlet. this is a plea to someone who i believe is still, deep down, good. a app invented to help people. to bring learning to those who need. to share knowledge, to support those around the world who want to help others learn too.
please do not let my cries fall on deaf ears, quizlet. this is not a angry, unforgiving rant. this is a serious, solemn request. i miss what you were quizlet. i long for who you could be, once more.
